defects.description: The SECRET_USERNAME env var's secretKeyRef names Secret `app-secret`, but the Secret defined in this manifest is named `test-secret`.
paraphrases: secretKeyRef points at `app-secret`, but only `test-secret` is defined.
The referenced Secret name should be `test-secret`, not `app-secret`.
Dangling Secret reference: `app-secret` is never defined.
defects.rationale: Findable by comparing the secretKeyRef name (line 21) to the Secret metadata.name (line 4); should be test-secret.

defects.description: The SECRET_USERNAME env var requests key `user`, but the Secret defines keys `username` and `password` — there is no `user` key.
paraphrases: The key `user` does not exist in the Secret (which has username and password).
Dangling key reference: `user` is not a key of the Secret.
defects.rationale: Findable by comparing the referenced key (line 22) to the Secret data keys (lines 6-7); should be username.

defects.description: The SECRET_PASSWORD env var requests key `passwd`, but the Secret defines the key as `password`.
paraphrases: The key `passwd` does not exist in the Secret (the key is `password`).
Dangling key reference: `passwd` is not a key of the Secret.
defects.rationale: Findable by comparing the referenced key (line 27) to the Secret data keys (lines 6-7); should be password.
